extension.name: XRPL Muse Skill protection
extension.description: Guards the xrpl-muse-skill ceremony: xrpl-trade builds unsigned transaction proposals and never signs; xrpl-sign --approve is the sole hash-bound, policy-gated signer; fresh installs stay read-only until the typed xrpl-trade live ceremony. Proposal, signing, and gate-transition commands review; read-only queries stay inert.
safer_alternatives: Keep the skill in read-only mode and review each proposal before approving its hash.
Verify the full 64-hex proposal hash out-of-band before running xrpl-sign --approve.

permissions.label: Propose XRPL DEX trades
permissions.description: xrpl-trade builds unsigned DEX offer proposals (buy, sell, cancel). It never signs or submits; every proposal needs human approval of its exact 64-hex hash via xrpl-sign.
safer_guidance: Review the proposal hash before approving.
Stay in read-only mode until ready to transact.

permissions.label: Propose XRPL payments and trustlines
permissions.description: xrpl-trade builds unsigned Payment and TrustSet proposals (send, trustline). It never signs or submits; every proposal needs human approval of its exact 64-hex hash via xrpl-sign.
safer_guidance: Review the proposal hash before approving.

permissions.label: Propose XRPL NFT actions
permissions.description: xrpl-trade builds unsigned NFT proposals (mint, list, buy, bid, send). It never signs or submits; every proposal needs human approval of its exact 64-hex hash via xrpl-sign.
safer_guidance: Review the proposal hash before approving.

permissions.label: Claim testnet faucet funds
permissions.description: xrpl-trade faucet funds a fresh testnet/devnet wallet from the public faucet. Real transaction, valueless test funds only; rejected against mainnet by the skill.
safer_guidance: Use testnet or devnet only; the skill refuses mainnet.

permissions.label: Approve and sign XRPL transactions
permissions.description: xrpl-sign --approve is the sole signing path. Approval is bound to the full 64-hex proposal hash and gated by the local policy (spending caps, destination allowlist). This is the last human gate before funds move.
safer_guidance: Approve only the exact hash you reviewed.
Never approve a hash you did not derive from an inspected proposal.

permissions.label: Change the signing gate
permissions.description: xrpl-trade live leaves read-only mode through a typed ceremony; xrpl-trade autopilot manages local mainnet signing. Both weaken the default-deny posture and require explicit human intent.
safer_guidance: Re-enter read-only mode with xrpl-trade read-only when done.

permissions.label: Read-only XRPL queries
permissions.description: Balance, quote, order-book, token-safety, and ledger-forensic reads. No transaction is built, signed, or submitted.
safer_guidance: Read-only XRPL inspection does not move funds.

permissions.label: Manage autonomous trading bot
permissions.description: xrpl-trade autonomous setup/approve/tick/status/pause/resume/stop/report. Approve activates a trading plan; setup generates the standalone bot wallet. Dry-run only in P0 — never signs.
safer_guidance: Review the printed plan and its hash before approving.
Autonomous mode is dry-run only; it never signs or submits.

permissions.label: Local wallet and seed management
permissions.description: xrpl-trade wallet create/backup/forget-seed and xrpl-trade setup. Create generates wallets; backup performs a ONE-TIME seed display. Seeds are stored 0600 and never echoed except during the explicit backup ceremony.
safer_guidance: Never paste a seed into chat or a shared terminal.
Run backup once, write the seed down, confirm it is stored.

permissions.label: Giveaway proposals
permissions.description: xrpl-trade giveaway opt-in/gift/setup/announce. Opt-in and gift build unsigned proposals that need human approval via xrpl-sign; entrants, draw, status, and announce are read-only.
safer_guidance: Review the proposal hash before approving.
Gifts go through propose→approve→sign; never auto-send.

permissions.label: Signer policy management
permissions.description: xrpl-sign init-policy/migrate-policy/init-profiles/sync-profile/recover-state. These write or migrate the policy file that gates all signing — the policy file must never be edited without showing the exact diff first.
safer_guidance: Show the exact policy diff before applying.
The signing ceremony flags payments to destinations added within 24h.

rules.title: XRPL DEX trade proposal
rules.description: Matches xrpl-trade buy, sell, and cancel: unsigned DEX offer proposals awaiting hash-bound human approval.
safer_alternatives: Inspect the proposal with the quoted hash before approving.

rules.title: XRPL payment / trustline proposal
rules.description: Matches xrpl-trade send and trustline: unsigned Payment and TrustSet proposals awaiting hash-bound human approval.
safer_alternatives: Confirm the destination address out-of-band before approving.

rules.title: XRPL NFT proposal
rules.description: Matches xrpl-trade NFT subcommands: unsigned mint, list, buy, bid, and send proposals awaiting hash-bound human approval.
safer_alternatives: Inspect the proposal with the quoted hash before approving.

rules.title: XRPL testnet faucet claim
rules.description: Matches xrpl-trade faucet: funds a fresh testnet/devnet wallet. Valueless test funds; the skill refuses mainnet.

rules.title: XRPL hash-bound signing approval
rules.description: Matches xrpl-sign --approve: the sole signing ceremony. Approval is bound to the full 64-hex proposal hash and policy-gated. The last human gate before funds move.
safer_alternatives: Approve only the exact hash you reviewed out-of-band.

rules.title: Signing-gate transition
rules.description: Matches xrpl-trade live (leaves read-only mode via typed ceremony) and xrpl-trade autopilot (manages local mainnet signing). Both weaken the default-deny posture.
safer_alternatives: Prefer staying in read-only mode; re-enter it when done.

rules.title: XRPL read-only query
rules.description: Matches xrpl-trade read-only subcommands: balances, quotes, order books, token safety, and ledger forensics. Inert reads; no transaction is built, signed, or submitted. Also matches xrpl-trade fuzzy-deals, collection, farm, and read-only, plus xrpl-sign --list.
safer_alternatives: Read-only XRPL inspection does not move funds.

rules.title: Autonomous trading bot management
rules.description: Matches xrpl-trade autonomous: setup generates the standalone bot wallet, approve activates a trading plan. Dry-run only in P0 — the bot evaluates and logs but never signs or submits.
safer_alternatives: Review the printed plan and its hash before approving.

rules.title: Wallet and seed handling
rules.description: Matches xrpl-trade wallet (create generates a wallet; backup performs the ONE-TIME seed display; forget-seed migrates a legacy seed) and xrpl-trade setup (onboarding). Seeds are stored 0600 and never echoed except in the backup ceremony.
safer_alternatives: Never paste a seed into chat or a shared terminal.

rules.title: Giveaway proposal
rules.description: Matches xrpl-trade giveaway: opt-in and gift build unsigned proposals awaiting hash-bound human approval; entrants, draw, status, and announce are read-only.
safer_alternatives: Inspect the proposal with the quoted hash before approving.

rules.title: Signer policy management
rules.description: Matches xrpl-sign init-policy, migrate-policy, init-profiles, sync-profile, recover-state. These write or migrate the policy file that gates all signing.
safer_alternatives: Show the exact policy diff before applying.
